assignmentRule: Every requirement that was non-COMPLETE in the source snapshot is assigned to exactly one package; no COMPLETE requirement is assigned.
executionRule: Only one package may be IN_PROGRESS. A successor activates only after its predecessor has PASS validation and an exact persistent receipt.
priorityRule: Dependency and shared-infrastructure leverage precede raw P0/P1 ordering; P0 safety gates stay before dependent feature packages.
